snippet.title: Crimson Moon - Date Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013260

Earlier this year, we introduced you to Crimson Moon, our gothic high renaissance action RPG where you play as a Nephilim - a powerful half-human, half-angel warrior sworn to reclaim the fallen city of Gildenarch from the demonic corruption consuming it.

Today, we're excited to announce that Crimson Moon is only weeks away, launching on PlayStation 5 on September 1.

#ps5 #ps5games #crimsonmoon 

Rated Mature
